author: mvafin
title: Manylinux 2_28 build fails to upload openvino_package artifact - FinalizeArtifact 403 Forbidden
signature: Failed to FinalizeArtifact non-retryable error 403 Forbidden|Infrastructure

failed_jobs.name: Build
failed_jobs.symptom: Upload OpenVINO package step failed: FinalizeArtifact received a non-retryable 403 Forbidden from the Actions artifact storage backend after the artifact content was fully uploaded.

failed_jobs.name: ci/gha_overall_status_manylinux_2_28
failed_jobs.symptom: Aggregation gate step 'Check status of all jobs' failed because the Build job it depends on failed.

root_cause: The Build job (attempt 1) successfully uploaded the full openvino_package.tar.gz content (~90 MB) to Actions blob storage, but the FinalizeArtifact call that commits the artifact was rejected with a non-retryable 403 Forbidden from an intermediary proxy fronting the Actions artifact service. This is a GitHub Actions artifact-service/infrastructure-side failure, not something the workflow or PR code caused: the upload content itself succeeded, only the finalize commit call was blocked. Attempt 1's Build job failed at the 'Upload OpenVINO package' step as a direct result, cascading to the overall status gate failing; attempt 2 of the run was cancelled before Build (job 106519180073, tail 22 bytes) even produced meaningful logs, consistent with the run being torn down/retried after the same recurring intermediary 403 pattern already seen twice before for this exact FinalizeArtifact signature.
reproduction_steps: N/A - not reproducible locally; this is a GitHub Actions-hosted Artifact service / edge-proxy failure that occurs only when a workflow run uploads an artifact through actions/upload-artifact (or the openvino-org fork of it) during a merge-queue build.
recommended_actions: Re-run only the failed jobs for this workflow run (a plain retry typically clears this since the failure is on GitHub's artifact-service intermediary, not the payload).
If the 403 recurs on retry, check the GitHub Actions status page (githubstatus.com) for Actions/Artifacts incidents around the failure timestamp.

Consider adding retry-with-backoff around the 'Upload OpenVINO package' step (actions/upload-artifact already retries transient network errors, but does not retry a non-retryable 403 from FinalizeArtifact) if this pattern's occurrence count keeps climbing.
prevention_strategies: This class of failure originates in GitHub's Actions artifact backend, not in OpenVINO CI configuration, so it cannot be fully prevented from this repository. Mitigate impact by keeping merge-queue rerun automation (workflow_rerun) tuned to this signature so transient service blips do not block merges, and periodically check for occurrence-rate trends that would indicate a broader GitHub Actions outage rather than a one-off blip.
historical_context: This exact failure signature (Failed to FinalizeArtifact non-retryable error 403 Forbidden) has now been seen 3 times: 2026-07-17 (PR #37029, RISC-V clang-tidy build), 2026-07-27 (PR #36905), and now 2026-09-21 (PR #38168, Manylinux 2_28 Build). All three occurrences are on unrelated jobs/PRs, confirming this is a shared, job-agnostic GitHub Actions artifact-service intermediary issue rather than a code or workflow-configuration defect.
